newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary capital to privatise public service corp.
newsitem.headline: Hungary capital to privatise public service corp.

text.p: The Budapest municipality plans to privatise public services company Fovarosi Kozteruletfenntarto by the end of next year, Deputy Mayor Pal Vajda said on Tuesday.
The company maintains Budapest's roads and public places and organises rubbish collection in the capital, which has two million inhabitants.
Vajda told a news conference that the municipality should spend 27 billion forints ($150 million) for developments at the company in the next few years, but 10 billion forints were missing.
"The privatisation would aim mainly at raising the company's capital," Vajda told a news conference, adding that the details of the sell-off have not been worked out yet.
He added that the capital recently published a tender for the privatisation of either a minority or a majority stake in district heating company Fotav.
